sources.summary: The design of the 4015 House and Studio reflects the global shift to working remotely, renovating a mid-century house set in the hills above Portland . Designed for an executive creative director and his family, the house focuses on smart space planning, rich materiality and fine detailing. After the completion of the house, a small, detached studio was commissioned for the client's creative practice.
